entities.name: Lithuanian & Polish Rule
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Battle of Blue Waters (1362) brought most Ukrainian lands under Lithuanian control. The Grand Duchy of Lithuania adopted Ruthenian (Old Ukrainian/Belarusian) as its official language. The Union of Krewo (1385) and increasing Polish influence transformed the region's political landscape.
